row.title: POST-FEEDBACK-1: engagement read back and scored per arm
row.body: Public like, repost and reply counts for Bluesky and Mastodon posts are read a day after posting, stored on social_posted and used to break ties between equally ranked posts. The relay's AI-generated marker (qnfo-social, Quniverse account, Art. 50) is left as is: its source is not in these repos and a redeploy without it risks losing bindings.
